messages.subject: How to save demographics?
parts:
Hello,

how do I get the values from the demographics page in an assessment? I get the responses from the questionnaire from person$raw_responses, but person$demographics does not seem to work. Do I have to provide the input ID that I set?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to save demographics?
parts:
Using str() can be helpful to see how internals are organized, but I'd recommend just extracting from a summary list output in case things move around in the future.

so <- summary(CAT_result)
so$demographics

Phil
